traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + five times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level)

traits.name: Charge
traits.desc: If the beast moves at least 20 feet straight toward a target and then hits it with a Maul attack on the same turn, the target takes an extra 1d6 Slashing damage. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Spell Save DC or have the Prone condition.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.desc: You can add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw that the beast makes.

actions.name: Maul
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + 2 + PB Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage (your choice when you summon the beast).

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + five times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d8s] equal to your Ranger level)

traits.name: Amphibious
traits.desc: The beast can breathe air and water.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.desc: You can add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw that the beast makes.

actions.name: Binding Strike
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d6 + 2 + PB Bludgeoning or Piercing damage (your choice), and the target has the Grappled condition (escape DC equals your Spell Save DC). Until this grapple ends, the beast can't use this attack on another target.

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 4 + four times your Ranger level (the beast has a number of Hit Dice [d6s] equal to your Ranger level)

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: The beast doesn't provoke Opportunity Attacks when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

traits.name: Primal Bond
traits.desc: You can add your Proficiency Bonus to any ability check or saving throw that the beast makes.

actions.name: Shred
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: your spell attack modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d4 + 3 + PB Slashing damage.

sb.name: Otherworldly Steed
sb.speed: 60 ft., fly 60 ft. (requires 4th-level spell or higher)
sb.languages: Telepathy 1 mile (only between you and the steed)

traits.name: Hit Points
traits.desc: 5 + 10 per spell level (the steed has a number of Hit Dice [d10s] equal to the spell's level)

traits.name: Life Bond
traits.desc: When you regain Hit Points from a spell of 1st level or higher, the steed regains the same number of Hit Points if you're within 5 feet of it.

actions.name: Otherworldly Slam
actions.desc: Melee Spell Attack: your Spell Attack Modifier to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 1d8 + the spell's level of Radiant damage (Celestial), Psychic damage (Fey), or Necrotic damage (Fiend).

bonus_actions.name: Fey Step (Fey Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The steed teleports, along with its rider, to an unoccupied space of your choice up to 60 feet away.

bonus_actions.name: Fell Glare (Fiend Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The steed's eyes gleam with fiendish light as it targets one creature it can perceive up to 60 feet away. The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your Spell Save DC or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.

bonus_actions.name: Healing Touch (Celestial Only; Recharges after a Long Rest)
bonus_actions.desc: The steed touches another creature and restores a number of Hit Points to it equal to 2d8 + the spell's level.
